name: gNBSim (OMEC / SD-Core)
what_it_is: A 5G gNodeB and UE simulator from the Aether/SD-Core project that generates NAS and NGAP messages to exercise a 5G Core Network. It supports multiple configurable test profiles covering the full 3GPP registration, PDU session, and release procedure set.
components: gNB simulator (N2 control plane, N3 user plane)
UE simulator (NAS layer, per-IMSI state machines)
Profile Manager (sequential or parallel profile execution engine)
HTTP API server (optional REST interface for runtime profile control)
Data plane engine (ICMP echo over GTP-U N3 tunnel)
measurement: Aggregate profile error reporting across all UEs
configuration: gnbsim.yaml: pool of gNBs (n2IpAddr, n2Port, n3IpAddr, n3Port, PLMN, TAC, S-NSSAI)
profiles[]: profileType, startImsi, ueCount, execInParallel, defaultAs, dnn, sNssai, dataPktCount
customProfiles[]: iteration chains with named steps and repeat counts (max 7 actions per iteration)
singleInterface: true/false (controls whether N2 and N3 share one IP)
execInParallel: true/false at both global and per-profile level
logger.logLevel: debug | info | warn | error | fatal | panic
fault_injection: retransMsg: true — enables retransmission of Service Request messages to simulate retry behavior
stepTrigger: true in customProfiles — pauses execution between steps, allowing controlled fault injection via HTTP step API
perUserTimeout — simulates timeout/failure conditions by treating a stalled UE as a failure
Profile enable/disable flags — selectively suppress procedure types to observe partial-flow behavior
modes: Aether In-a-Box (AIAB) integrated mode with SD-Core
Multi-interface mode (separate N2 and N3 IPs, requires Multus CNI)
constraints: No docker-compose file in repository — deployment is via standalone binary, Docker run, or Helm/AIAB; no compose-based local stack is provided
Single-interface mode supports only one gNB instance per simulator process (port 2152 conflict prevents multiple gNBs)
Custom profile iterations are capped at 7 actions per iteration block
HTTP step-trigger API requires stepTrigger: true in the custom profile config; standard profiles cannot be stepped externally
GTP-U echo request/response and N2 handover (Xn/N2) are listed as pending features — not yet implemented
GUTI-based registration and Resynchronization Profile are pending — only IMSI-based registration is supported
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml in the repository (neither main nor master branch)
No built-in traffic generator beyond ICMP echo — iperf or other application-layer load is not supported natively
No support for aborting, suspending, or resuming running profiles via API
